name: Breeze Block
description: Mid-century concrete screen blocks pierced with four petals and a round eye, the petals of neighboring blocks meeting as flowers at every joint.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: -20.711%; top: -20.711%; width: 141.421%; height: 141.421%; transform: rotate(45deg); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--bc); clip-path: @var(--bc); -webkit-mask: @var(--bh); mask: @var(--bh); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --bc: polygon(2.6% 50%, 50% 2.6%, 97.4% 50%, 50% 97.4%); --bh: radial-gradient(15% 7.4% at 20% 50%, transparent 100%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(15% 7.4% at 80% 50%, transparent 100%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7.4% 15% at 50% 20%, transparent 100%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(7.4% 15% at 50% 80%, transparent 100%, #000 100%), radial-gradient(9.5% 9.5% at 50% 50%, transparent 100%, #000 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
